use_cases.name: Register User
use_cases.goal: Create a new user account with login, password, and role
preconditions: No existing user with the same login
postconditions: User account is saved in database

main_flow.action: Sends POST /register request with login, password, role
Validates request data (non-empty fields, valid role)
Encrypts password and saves user to database
Returns success response with user details

use_cases.name: Login & Get JWT
use_cases.goal: Authenticate user and receive JWT token for authorized requests

main_flow.action: Sends POST /login request with login and password
Validates credentials against database
Generates JWT token with user role
Returns JWT token in response

use_cases.name: Manage Books
use_cases.goal: Create, update, or delete books in the catalog
preconditions: ADMIN is authenticated with valid JWT

main_flow.action: Sends POST/PUT/DELETE /books request with JWT and book data
Validates JWT and ADMIN role
Performs CRUD operation on Book entity
Returns success response with updated book data

use_cases.name: Browse Books
use_cases.goal: View paginated list of all books with optional filters
preconditions: User is authenticated with valid JWT
postconditions: Book list is displayed to user

main_flow.action: Sends GET /books request with JWT and optional filter params
Validates JWT
Queries database for books with pagination/filters
Returns paginated book list

use_cases.name: Search Books
use_cases.goal: Find books by keyword (name/description) with pagination
preconditions: User is authenticated with valid JWT

main_flow.action: Sends GET /books/search request with JWT, query, and page params
Validates JWT
Searches database for books matching keyword
Returns paginated search results

use_cases.name: View Book Details
use_cases.goal: View full details of a single book by ID
preconditions: User is authenticated with valid JWT

main_flow.action: Sends GET /books/{id} request with JWT
Validates JWT and queries book by ID
Returns book details

use_cases.name: Add Book to Cart
use_cases.goal: Add a specific book to the customer's cart
preconditions: CUSTOMER is authenticated with valid JWT
postconditions: Book is added to customer's cart

main_flow.action: Sends POST /cart/add/{bookId} request with JWT and customerId
Validates JWT, customerId, and bookId
Adds book to cart (creates cart if not exists)
Returns updated cart details

use_cases.name: View Cart
use_cases.goal: View all books in the customer's cart
preconditions: CUSTOMER is authenticated with valid JWT

main_flow.action: Sends GET /cart request with JWT and customerId
Validates JWT and retrieves cart by customerId
Returns cart details with books

use_cases.name: Checkout Cart
use_cases.goal: Create a new order from the customer's cart
preconditions: CUSTOMER is authenticated with valid JWT
Cart has at least one book

main_flow.action: Sends POST /orders/checkout request with JWT and customerId
Validates JWT and retrieves cart by customerId
Calculates total price from cart books
Creates new Order entity with status COMPLETED
Clears the customer's cart
Returns created order details

use_cases.name: View Order History
use_cases.goal: View all past orders for the customer
preconditions: CUSTOMER is authenticated with valid JWT

main_flow.action: Sends GET /orders request with JWT and customerId
Validates JWT and queries orders by customerId
Returns list of orders with books and total price
